बॉलीवुड के गलियारों से एक बड़ी और धमाकेदार खबर सामने आ रही है! 🎬

प्रोड्यूसर Ektaa R Kapoor एक बार फिर बड़े पर्दे पर खौफ का नया तड़का लगाने के लिए तैयार हैं। इस नई horror फिल्म के लिए उन्होंने Housefull के डायरेक्टर Sajid Khan और Bajrangi Bhaijaan के प्रोड्यूसर Amar Butala के साथ हाथ मिलाया है।

मेकर्स 13 November को इस प्रोजेक्ट के टाइटल का ऑफिशियल अनाउंसमेंट करने जा रहे हैं। इससे पहले Ektaa R Kapoor ने Bhooth Bangla और The Vvaan जैसी फिल्मों से थिएटर्स में अपनी मौजूदगी दर्ज कराई है।

Sajid Khan इससे पहले Heyy Babyy और Housefull जैसी सुपरहिट फिल्में डायरेक्ट कर चुके हैं, वहीं Amar Butala Kesari और Mission Majnu जैसी फिल्मों से जुड़े रहे हैं। हालांकि फिल्म की स्टारकास्ट, कहानी और रिलीज डेट का खुलासा अभी नहीं हुआ है।

क्या आप Sajid Khan और Ektaa R Kapoor की इस नई horror जोड़ी के लिए एक्साइटेड हैं? कमेंट में अपनी राय जरूर बताएं! 👁️✨

ctx.text:
The producer is set to add another theatrical project to her slate, bringing together the filmmaker behind Housefull and the producer of Bajrangi Bhaijaan.
Ektaa R Kapoor is gearing up for another theatrical outing, this time joining forces with producer Amar Butala and director Sajid Khan for a new film. The makers are set to unveil the title of the upcoming project on November 13, with the film marking Kapoor's return to the horror genre following her recent theatrical ventures.
The collaboration brings together three names with experience in mainstream Hindi cinema. While Kapoor has backed several successful entertainers across genres, Butala has been associated with films such as Bajrangi Bhaijaan , Kesari and Mission Majnu . Sajid Khan, meanwhile, is known for directing commercial entertainers including Heyy Babyy and the first two films in the Housefull franchise.
Although details about the project are currently being kept under wraps, the upcoming film is said to offer a distinct cinematic experience. The title announcement is expected to provide the first official glimpse into the project, with further details awaited.
The development comes after a notable year for Kapoor's theatrical slate. Her recent releases include Bhooth Bangla , starring Akshay Kumar and directed by Priyadarshan, and The Vvaan , featuring Sidharth Malhotra and Tamannaah Bhatia. While the former revisited the horror-comedy space, the latter explored folklore and supernatural elements against an Indian setting.
With her next project also returning to horror, Kapoor continues to expand her theatrical lineup with genre-driven stories. The association with Sajid Khan and Amar Butala adds another interesting combination of filmmaking and production experience to the project.
The film's title will be officially announced on November 13, with details about its cast, storyline and release schedule yet to be revealed.
